## 4c. Dumbbell Bench Press

Exercise Objective: Develop strength and stability in the pectorals, shoulders, and triceps

## Start Position

1. Grasp a dumbbell in each hand with a closed grip and sit on the bench
2. Lie flat on the bench in a five-point body contact position with arms extended (-67)

## Procedure

1. Take a deep breath to fill the chest with air and engage the core to prevent the back from arching
2. Lower the dumbbells slowly and under control keeping hands over shoulders until the dumbbells reach chest level (-68)
3. Drive the weight off the chest extending elbows
4. Exhale as you near the top of the lift
